versions.content: If the underlying EEPROM device or device driver does not provide at least the configured number of erase/write cycles per physical memory cell (given in the parameter EepAllowedWriteCycles), the EA module shall provide mechanisms to spread the erase/ write access such that the physical device is not overstressed. This shall also apply to all management data used internally by the EA module.
